name: @adventure-keeper/realtime-server
description: Self-hosted realtime server for Adventure Keeper live sessions: one in-memory room per session, over WebSocket.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node26 --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
